name: cloth leggings
_design_note: F1-20 light legs slot. Lowest-tier leg covering — quilted hose. Covers cloth_leggings, padded_leggings from legacy data.
lore_template: Quilted {material_name} leggings cut full at the thigh and tapered at the calf, worn beneath outer breeches or as standalone hose. They turn a glancing blade aside more often than the wearer might expect — though only the first time per garment. After that the wearer learns where the blade went through, and the wearer learns to be careful there.
